content.short: Resistance Cat (RECA) is a guardian project on TON that vets new protocols to protect users from scams.
content.description: Resistance Cat (RECA) is a community-driven 'guardian' project on the TON blockchain with a mission to protect users from the risks of decentralized finance. It functions as a vetting platform for new projects, providing educational resources and conducting community reviews to identify potential scams or low-quality protocols. RECA utilizes its social token to coordinate these efforts, empowering its members to contribute to the ecosystem's safety and integrity. By fostering a culture of due diligence and transparency, Resistance Cat is a vital resource for both new and experienced TON users.
content.meta: Stay secure with Resistance Cat, the TON ecosystem guardian. Project vetting and safety on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
